chat.author: James Mozley
chat.text: Implementation issues with new record types include; firewalls blocking unknown types, implementation in DNS servers rather than passing unknown types, surrounding infrastructure such as telemetry being unaware, registry and registrar systems, etc. So while one might argue registering a new record type is trivial that doesn't allow for the implementation. Moving to register new record types now is not consensus it is a unilateral implementation that doesn't solicit input from the community. It will take time to get consensus on any new record types, plus the length of implementation. Using an existing record type of SVCB seems easier to implement and is halfway between a formatted TXT record that is a PITA if it is at the apex and a new record type.
